findings.evidence: Direct execution of rendered_parents returns {12} for both linked examples, whereas their plain-text equivalents return set(). Lines 313–318 substitute the canonical identity and suppress the label; line 651 accepts explicit membership as relationship evidence, enabling explicit-parent-content evidence at line 706 and enforcement at line 941.
findings.fix: Require canonical link labels to pass qualification/alternative checks before granting declaration authority; add regressions for both cases, including formatted labels and independent identical source content.
findings.issue: Canonical links erase qualifications: both `Depends on [#12 or #13](.../pull/12).` and `Depends on [#12 (optional)](.../pull/12).` become unconditional parent #12 declarations.

summary: The prior zero-content defect is fixed, but canonical link-label suppression still turns qualified or alternative dependencies into unconditional declarations that can authorize false closure.
